# Cestrix Group

> Cestrix Group Limited is a premier multinational conglomerate specializing in heavy civil infrastructure engineering (EPC) and enterprise digital technology integration.

## Corporate Structure & Key Portals

### 1. Global Gateway
- [Cestrix Global Gateway](https://cestrixgroup.com/): Central corporate overview, portal selector, and cross-divisional routing.

### 2. Cestrix Infrastructure Division
Engaged in heavy civil developments, high-altitude transport corridors, marine structures, and monumental engineering projects.
- [Infra Division Overview](https://cestrixgroup.com/infra): Heavy infrastructure capabilities, fleet logistics, and EPC contracts.
- [Projects Portal](https://cestrixgroup.com/infra/projects): Active and completed monumental engineering assignments.
- [Fleet & Machinery](https://cestrixgroup.com/infra/fleet): Telematics-enabled heavy machinery and equipment assets.
- [ESG & Sustainability](https://cestrixgroup.com/infra/sustainability): Carbon-neutral concrete, environmental compliance, and green building standards.
- [Commercial Tenders](https://cestrixgroup.com/infra/tender): Procurement, joint-venture bidding, and RFQ submissions.

### 3. Cestrix Technology Division
Delivering custom B2B enterprise software, industrial IoT telematics, 3D/5D Digital Twin simulations, and zero-trust cloud architectures.
- [Tech Division Overview](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech): Digital ecosystem integration, enterprise software, and cloud systems.
- [Industries Served](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech/industry): Solutions tailored for EPC engineering, aviation, maritime, energy, and defense.
- [Services & Capabilities](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech/services): Custom ERP development, Digital Twin modeling, IoT tracking, and cyber defense.
- [Corporate Insights](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech/insights): Engineering whitepapers, technology analysis, and case studies.
- [About Tech Division](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech/about-us): Corporate mission, leadership team, and innovation standards.

### 4. Corporate Governance & Legal
- [Privacy Policy](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech/privacy): Data privacy policies, ISO/IEC 27001 zero-trust security standards.
- [Terms of Use](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech/terms): Enterprise portal terms, usage agreements, and IP rights.
- [Legal Disclaimer](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech/disclaimer): Technical estimation disclaimers and engineering liability baselines.
- [Cookies Policy](https://cestrixgroup.com/tech/cookies): Cookie architecture, tracking compliance, and user options.

## Core Capabilities & Specializations
- **Heavy Infrastructure (EPC):** Highways, bridge structures, deep-foundation piling, marine harbors, and aviation runways.
- **Digital Twin & BIM Integration:** 3D/5D building information modeling and real-time site simulation.
- **Industrial IoT & Telematics:** Real-time heavy fleet telemetry, fuel optimization, and predictive equipment maintenance.
- **Enterprise Software Development:** Proprietary ERP and supply-chain platforms designed specifically for large-scale contracting.
